title: Henry Middelmore to Secretary Cecil, 19 and 26 July 1563, BL Add MS 4136 ff. 155-157 (DECODE R9246, R9247)

transcription.source: DECODE images (Forbes's copy of the ciphered passages)
transcription.notes: 46 numbered passages on ff.155-157; not transcribed (printed). The same record also holds the 26 July letter and the foot of f.157 (Smith 17 Jan 1562/3).

transcription.source: DECODE images (Forbes's copy of the ciphered passages)
transcription.notes: Image identical to R9246 image 3. 26 passages; only the passages used for the key check transcribed.

system.summary: Middelmore's own cipher: about 25 signs (dotted digits and symbols) for letters, words kept apart, and code signs (∞ = Newhaven). Not Smith's key R9261. Checked on passages (1),(2),(4),(6),(9) of 26 July against Forbes's printed text.
system.notes: Key not fully rebuilt; the printed text covers every passage.

prior_solution.where: Patrick Forbes, A Full View of the Public Transactions in the Reign of Q. Elizabeth, vol. II (London 1741), pp. 470-75 and 490-92

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched R9246 (3 images) and R9247 (1 image) with the shared DECODE cookie; R9247 is byte-identical to R9246 image 3.
Compared with Smith's key R9261 (same volume): different sign set, does not apply. No Middelmore key among R9260-R9262.
Grepped the Forbes Full View ii OCR (from smith1562) for Middelmore: both letters printed in full from the originals, Rouen 19 July and Vallemont 26 July 1563.
Aligned 26 July passages (1)=(6) 'my grief', (2) 'sorrows', (4),(9) ∞ 'Newhaven' with Forbes; consistent monoalphabetic fit (∓=m, λ=y/i, ω=g, 4=r, 8=e, ⊏=f).

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): Forbes ii (1741) printed texts of both letters copied from the archive.org OCR to texts/; the 26 July spot-check signs (transcription_26jul.txt, 7 passages only); the cipher of the 19 July letter and the rest of 26 July were never transcribed (project work)

Full-texts audit, R9246 (19 July letter): looked for a transcription in the folder (only transcription_26jul.txt, seven passages of the other letter), on the DECODE record (public API and record page: three images, no transcription). Tried to fetch the images to transcribe the 46 passages: DECODE answers an anonymous request with its 'forbidden' placeholder, and no session is available here. transcription_missing recorded on the 19 July entry.

outcome.method_basis: Both letters are printed in full with the ciphered words deciphered in Forbes, A Full View, vol. II (1741), pp. 470-75 and 490-92; the cipher was only spot-checked against that print.
outcome.notes: Printed 1741 by Forbes. Catalogue entry 91 removed, no write-up.

texts.label: R9246 ff. 155-157, Rouen, 19 July 1563 (passages (1)-(46))
texts.transcription_missing: Never transcribed: the 46 numbered passages of the 19 July letter (BL Add MS 4136 ff. 155-157, Forbes's copy, graphic signs and figures) were identified from the printed text, not copied; only seven passages of the 26 July letter were transcribed (transcription_26jul.txt). The DECODE images of this record need a signed-in session: on 14 Nov 2026 an anonymous request for them to decrypt-custom/filesrv returned DECODE's 'forbidden' placeholder, only 200 px thumbnails are public, and the record (public API and record page) carries no transcription. No DECODE session is available in this checkout and the images fetched earlier were git-ignored and are no longer here. Unblocks it: the record's images through a DECODE account (or from the British Library), then a transcription against a sign inventory for Middelmore's cipher, checked by decoding against texts/R9246_19jul_forbes.txt.
texts.summary: Henry Middelmore to Secretary Cecil from Rouen during the siege of Newhaven (Le Havre): his audience with the Prince of Condé after Barlow's departure, and the French King's march on Newhaven. Printed in full, deciphered, by Forbes (1741).

texts.label: R9246 f. 157 = R9247, Vallemont, 26 July 1563 (passages (1)-(26))
texts.summary: Middelmore to Cecil from Vallemont, two leagues from Fécamp: his grief and sorrows at the dangers to Newhaven. Printed in full, deciphered, by Forbes (1741); R9247 is a duplicate image of the same page.
